summary:
Plan written for migration-rebind-1 (migration-tools r1, r2, r4, r5): 18 scenarios, 21 test ids; 20 green today, 1 red.
The red one is r4 'gives spec/index.md whose id is bounded-context/shop the id bounded-context/<path>'. Its Given writes spec/index.md without committing, so migrate's r15 uncommitted-tree refusal fires and nothing is written.
Decision: commit in that Given (tests/scenarios/migration_safety_steps.py) with the fixture's existing commit. No product change; rests on r15 and r4.
Tests broken: none. The r5 context-id scenario shares the Given and its second Given still has notes/n1.md to commit.
Open cases: an index already holding the new id, reference-style links, a moved path inside a longer path.
